paras: The Alpha-N Class 3 Wing Carbon Gurney Flap Set is a precision aerodynamic upgrade designed to enhance the performance of the Alpha-N Class 3 Rear Wing on the BMW M2 G87 2023+ and BMW 2-Series G42 2021+, and is available in Australia through iilumolab. Engineered and manufactured in Germany by Alpha-N Performance, a brand with deep roots in BMW motorsport, this gurney flap set increases rear downforce and improves high-speed stability while maintaining a clean, motorsport-inspired appearance.

By increasing the pressure differential across the rear wing, the gurney flap improves aerodynamic efficiency and allows the wing to generate additional downforce without requiring a larger or more aggressive wing profile. The result is improved rear-end grip, better traction under acceleration, and increased confidence during high-speed cornering and braking.
